summary: Select only the multipart/related root as body content and expose non-root related resources through explicit attachment review.
decision_refs: The active goal requires better RFI, Submittal and Email accuracy and adaptability
FR-PARSE-007 requires attachment and body evidence boundaries
Offline reproduction showed a related inline resource changing a parent RFI response to MIXED while remaining absent from attachment inventory
approval_evidence: The persistent user goal explicitly requires continued accuracy and adaptability improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
known_limitations: Related resources remain inert until a reviewer explicitly imports them; automatic recursion is not added.
A missing or unmatched multipart/related start parameter falls back to the RFC-defined first child.
The generated fallback name identifies an unnamed resource but does not infer an original filename.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no customer email, mailbox or provider API is used.
